headline: 10 injured, including 4 journalists, in attack by Chhatra Dal at RU
summary: Journalists were assaulted while filming a procession of Chhatra Dal activists carrying traditional weapons at Rajshahi University.
details: At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in an attack by Chhatra Dal activists at Rajshahi University (RU) on Sunday night.
The incident occurred around 8:30 PM in front of the Shahid Ziaur Rahman Hall after activists held a procession from the transport market area.
Witnesses report that several activists in the procession were openly carrying traditional sharp weapons, including ramdaos.
Journalists were assaulted and harassed when they attempted to video record the activists carrying weapons during their professional duties.
The tension on campus reportedly stemmed from a Facebook post and comment regarding RU Central Student Union (RAKSU) GS Salahuddin Ammar.
Sultan Ahmed own Rahy, president of the RU Chhatra Dal, stated they are investigating the incident and will take disciplinary action against any member found involved.
The JCD has formed a probe body to investigate the attack on journalists and students.
caption:
Journalists were assaulted at Rajshahi University while filming activists carrying sharp weapons. 10 people are injured.

At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in an attack by Chhatra Dal activists at Rajshahi University (RU) on Sunday night.

The incident occurred around 8:30 PM in front of the Shahid Ziaur Rahman Hall after activists held a procession from the transport market area.

Witnesses report that several activists in the procession were openly carrying traditional sharp weapons, including ramdaos.

Journalists were assaulted and harassed when they attempted to video record the activists carrying weapons during their professional duties.

The tension on campus reportedly stemmed from a Facebook post and comment regarding RU Central Student Union (RAKSU) GS Salahuddin Ammar.

Sultan Ahmed own Rahy, president of the RU Chhatra Dal, stated they are investigating the incident and will take disciplinary action against any member found involved.

The JCD has formed a probe body to investigate the attack on journalists and students.

headline_marked: 10-year journey ends: [[Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira announce divorce]]
headline: 10-year journey ends: Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira announce divorce
summary: The musician and model couple cited significant differences in mutual understanding as the reason for their separation after a decade together.
details: Musician and actor Pritom Hasan and model, actor and singer Shahtaj Monira Hashem have announced the end of their marriage. The couple shared the decision in separate Facebook posts on Sunday night.
Pritom stated that after a ten-year long journey together, they decided to end their marital relationship due to differences in their mutual understanding.
Both Pritom and Shahtaj expressed gratitude for the time, memories, and experiences they shared, stating that their respect and good wishes for each other will always remain.
The decision was not sudden; it was reached after much thought, discussion, and with the support and consent of their families. They are currently undergoing the divorce process.
The couple first met in 2017 while working on the music video for Pritom's popular song 'Jadukor', where Shahtaj appeared as a model.
After several years of dating, they married on October 29, 2022, in Sreemangal, in the presence of family and close friends.
Both have requested respect for their privacy and personal space during this transition, asking friends, colleagues, and the media to approach the matter with empathy.
While they were seen together as recently as January this year, sources close to the couple say their relationship had been struggling for some time.
caption:
After a decade of togetherness, Pritom Hasan and Shahtaj Monira are parting ways.

Musician and actor Pritom Hasan and model, actor and singer Shahtaj Monira Hashem have announced the end of their marriage. The couple shared the decision in separate Facebook posts on Sunday night.

Pritom stated that after a ten-year long journey together, they decided to end their marital relationship due to differences in their mutual understanding.

Both Pritom and Shahtaj expressed gratitude for the time, memories, and experiences they shared, stating that their respect and good wishes for each other will always remain.

The decision was not sudden; it was reached after much thought, discussion, and with the support and consent of their families. They are currently undergoing the divorce process.

The couple first met in 2017 while working on the music video for Pritom's popular song 'Jadukor', where Shahtaj appeared as a model.

After several years of dating, they married on October 29, 2022, in Sreemangal, in the presence of family and close friends.

Both have requested respect for their privacy and personal space during this transition, asking friends, colleagues, and the media to approach the matter with empathy.

While they were seen together as recently as January this year, sources close to the couple say their relationship had been struggling for some time.
